lines.trans: One tiny square envelope left—and the red wax seal is still completely unbroken!
Look at the compass rose pressed into the wax; that matches your professor, Rami.
Read the instruction written across the front before anyone touches a paper knife, Nour.
It says: Honour system! Walk all four clues on Jasmine Street before opening this letter!
Honour system means no peeking early at the front desk, even for the boss.
How long would it take us to follow all four illustrated cards down Jasmine Street?
The rooms are tidy, breakfast is cleared, and the morning sun is shining brightly!

words.gloss: in a way / in a shape

lines.trans: Go on, both of you, and take Mazen so he stops pacing around my lobby.
Will you guard the biscuit tin and the front desk while we walk, Tariq?
My paper ledger and I are not moving an inch until lunch.
Brass compass in my pocket, four clue cards in hand—where does Card One start?

meanings.note: Plural of دليل (dalīl), meaning proof or evidence.

examples.text: الشرطة لقت أدلة جديدة.
examples.trans: The police found new evidence.

examples.text: جمعنا كل الأدلة والوثائق قبل الاجتماع.
examples.trans: We gathered all the evidence and documents before the meeting.

meanings.note: The number four, used with feminine nouns.

examples.text: عندي أربع سيارات.
examples.trans: I have four cars.

examples.text: ضل أربع ساعات على موعد الطيارة.
examples.trans: There are four hours left until the flight time.

meanings.note: Everyday Jordanian word for seeing a group of people.

examples.text: أشوفكم بكرة في المدرسة.
examples.trans: I will see you tomorrow at school.

examples.text: يلا مع السلامة، أشوفكم الأسبوع الجاي إن شاء الله.
examples.trans: Alright, goodbye—see you all next week, God willing.

meanings.note: First person singular pronoun.

examples.text: أنا من الأردن.
examples.trans: I am from Jordan.

examples.text: أنا وإياك رح نخلص المشروع قبل يوم الخميس.
examples.trans: You and I will finish the project before Thursday.

meanings.note: Used as a question word or indefinite pronoun.

examples.text: أي سيارة بتفضل؟
examples.trans: Which car do you prefer?

examples.text: بأي ساعة رح يبلش الاجتماع اليوم؟
examples.trans: At what hour is the meeting going to start today?

meanings.note: Measurement unit.

examples.text: الشاشة حجمها خمسين إنش.
examples.trans: The screen size is fifty inches.

examples.text: طول اللوح الخشبي أربعين إنش بالزبط.
examples.trans: The length of the wooden board is forty inches exactly.

meanings.note: Command to a female to read.

examples.text: اقرأي الدرس بصوت عالي.
examples.trans: Read the lesson out loud.

examples.text: اقرأي البطاقة بصوت عالي عشان كلنا نسمع.
examples.trans: Read the card out loud so all of us can hear.

meanings.note: The color red with the definite article.

examples.text: القميص الأحمر بيعجبني.
examples.trans: I like the red shirt.

examples.text: القلم الأحمر ضايع ومو لاقيه بالمكتب.
examples.trans: The red pen is missing and I can't find it in the office.

meanings.note: Definite plural for proof/evidence.

examples.text: الأدلة مو كافية للمحكمة.
examples.trans: The evidence is not enough for the court.

examples.text: فحصنا الأدلة الموجودة بالملف وحدة وحدة.
examples.trans: We examined the evidence in the file one by one.

meanings.note: The number four with the definite article.

examples.text: الأولاد الأربعة راحوا عالمدرسة.
examples.trans: The four boys went to school.

examples.text: الأصدقاء الأربعة اتفقوا يلتقوا بالمقهى يوم السبت.
examples.trans: The four friends agreed to meet at the café on Saturday.

meanings.note: Feminine definite form of first, commonly used to describe the first instance of a feminine noun.

examples.text: هي المرة الأولى اللي بزور فيها البتراء.
examples.trans: This is the first time I visit Petra.

examples.text: المرة الأولى اللي بعزف فيها قدام جمهور كانت بتخوّف.
examples.trans: The first time I played in front of an audience was scary.

meanings.note: Refers to the day of the week (Monday) or the number two.

examples.text: بشوفك يوم الاثنين الجاي.
examples.trans: I will see you next Monday.

examples.text: اجتماعنا الجاي رح يكون يوم الاثنين الصبح.
examples.trans: Our next meeting will be on Monday morning.

meanings.note: Refers to a reception area in a hotel or hospital, or the act of welcoming.

examples.text: خلينا نستنى في صالة الاستقبال.
examples.trans: Let's wait in the reception hall.

examples.text: سألت موظف الاستقبال عن رقم الغرفة والمفتاح.
examples.trans: I asked the reception clerk for the room number and the key.

meanings.note: Collective noun for biscuits or cookies.

examples.text: الأولاد أكلوا كل البسكوت.
examples.trans: The kids ate all the biscuits.

examples.text: حطّيت صحن البسكوت والشاي عالطاولة للضيوف.
examples.trans: I put the plate of biscuits and tea on the table for the guests.

meanings.note: Plural of card, used for ID cards, bank cards, or tickets.

examples.text: نسيت البطاقات في البيت.
examples.trans: I forgot the cards at home.

examples.text: رتّبنا البطاقات البريدية كلها جوا الصندوق الخشبي.
examples.trans: We organized all the postcards inside the wooden box.

meanings.note: Singular of cards, refers to any physical card or ticket.

examples.text: أعطيني البطاقة الشخصية لو سمحت.
examples.trans: Give me your ID card, please.

examples.text: لا تنسى تاخد البطاقة البنكية معك قبل ما تطلع.
examples.trans: Don't forget to take your bank card with you before leaving.

meanings.note: Navigation tool, sometimes used metaphorically for guidance.

examples.text: ضاعوا بالصحرا لأنهم نسوا البوصلة.
examples.trans: They got lost in the desert because they forgot the compass.

examples.text: البوصلة القديمة بتشير دايماً لجهة الشمال.
examples.trans: The old compass always points toward the north.

meanings.note: Guidelines or rules to be followed.

examples.text: لازم تتبع التعليمات المكتوبة.
examples.trans: You must follow the written instructions.

examples.text: اقرا التعليمات اللي عالعلبة قبل ما تفتح الجهاز.
examples.trans: Read the instructions on the box before opening the device.

meanings.note: Peeking or spying on others in a sneaky way.

examples.text: بطل التلصص على الجيران.
examples.trans: Stop snooping on the neighbors.

examples.text: التلصص على خصوصيات الناس عادة سيئة كتير.
examples.trans: Snooping into people's private affairs is a very bad habit.

meanings.note: Used for main streets, main gates, or main issues.

examples.text: الشارع مسكر عند الإشارة الرئيسية.
examples.trans: The street is closed at the main traffic light.

examples.text: البوابة الرئيسية للجامعة بتسكر الساعة عشرة بالليل.
examples.trans: The main gate of the university closes at ten at night.

meanings.note: Can refer to a physical letter, an SMS/WhatsApp message, or an academic thesis.

examples.text: وصلتني الرسالة منك الصبح.
examples.trans: I received the message from you in the morning.

examples.text: بعتتلك الرسالة على الواتساب بس ما رديت علي.
examples.trans: I sent you the message on WhatsApp, but you didn't reply to me.

meanings.note: Refers to personal or family honor.

examples.text: الشرف غالي عندنا.
examples.trans: Honor is precious to us.

examples.text: إلنا الشرف نرحب فيكم ببيتنا بأي وقت.
examples.trans: We have the honor of welcoming you into our home anytime.

meanings.note: Collective noun for wax or candles.

examples.text: ولع الشمع عشان الكهربا قطعت.
examples.trans: Light the candles because the electricity went out.

examples.text: حطينا الشمع على الطاولة وزينا الغرفة لعيد الميلاد.
examples.trans: We put the candles on the table and decorated the room for the birthday.

meanings.note: Everyday Jordanian word for morning time.

examples.text: بصحى الصبح بكير.
examples.trans: I wake up early in the morning.

examples.text: بشرب فنجان قهوة كل يوم الصبح قبل ما أطلع عالشغل.
examples.trans: I drink a cup of coffee every morning before heading out to work.

meanings.note: The main meal of the day, usually eaten in the afternoon.

examples.text: تفضلوا على الغدا.
examples.trans: Please join us for lunch.

examples.text: سخنا المنسف عشان يكون الغدا جاهز على التنتين.
examples.trans: We heated up the mansaf so lunch would be ready at two o'clock.

meanings.note: Plural of room.

examples.text: نظفت كل الغرف.
examples.trans: I cleaned all the rooms.

examples.text: دهنا كل الغرف بالبيت لون أبيض قبل العرس.
examples.trans: We painted all the rooms in the house white before the wedding.

meanings.note: Passive participle for something drawn.

examples.text: اللوحة المرسومة حلوة.
examples.trans: The drawn painting is beautiful.

examples.text: الوردة المرسومة على الفنجان شغل يدوي دقيق.
examples.trans: The flower painted on the cup is delicate handmade work.

meanings.note: Printed (feminine) or a printout document.

examples.text: الورقة المطبوعة على الطاولة.
examples.trans: The printed paper is on the table.

examples.text: أخدنا النسخة المطبوعة من المعاملة عشان نقدمها بالبنك.
examples.trans: We took the printed copy of the paperwork to submit it at the bank.

meanings.note: Written (feminine).

examples.text: الكلمة المكتوبة بتضل للأبد.
examples.trans: The written word lasts forever.

examples.text: راجعت الملاحظات المكتوبة بالدفتر قبل الاجتماع.
examples.trans: I reviewed the notes written in the notebook before the meeting.

meanings.note: Front or facade of a building.

examples.text: واجهة العمارة قزاز كامل.
examples.trans: The building's facade is fully glass.

examples.text: نظفوا الواجهة القزاز للمحل قبل الافتتاح.
examples.trans: They cleaned the shop's glass storefront before the opening.

meanings.note: Paper or leaves (collective).

examples.text: جيب معك شوية الورق عشان نكتب.
examples.trans: Bring some paper with you so we can write.

examples.text: خلص الورق من الطابعة ولازم نجيب رزمة جديدة.
examples.trans: The printer ran out of paper and we need to get a new ream.

meanings.note: Made of paper or relating to paper.

examples.text: الكيس الورقي أحسن للبيئة.
examples.trans: The paper bag is better for the environment.

examples.text: بحب أقرأ الكتاب الورقي أكثر من النسخة الإلكترونية.
examples.trans: I prefer reading a paper book rather than the electronic copy.

meanings.note: Walk! (directed to a group).

examples.text: امشوا بسرعة عشان ما نتأخر.
examples.trans: Walk quickly so we don't get late.

examples.text: امشوا شوي شوي عالدرج عشان ما تزحلقوا.
examples.trans: Walk slowly on the stairs so you do not slip.

meanings.note: You all (alternative spelling).

examples.text: انتوا أحسن ناس عرفتهم.
examples.trans: You all are the best people I have known.

examples.text: انتوا التنتين عملتوا شغل ممتاز اليوم.
examples.trans: You two did an excellent job today.

meanings.note: Was removed or lifted.

examples.text: الكرسي انشال من مكانه.
examples.trans: The chair was removed from its place.

examples.text: الغطا انشال عن الصينية قبل ما تبرد.
examples.trans: The cover was lifted off the tray before it cooled.

بإيدي.gloss: with my hand / in my hand

meanings.en: with my hand / in my hand
meanings.note: In my hand or with my hand.

examples.text: عملت الأكل هاد بإيدي.
examples.trans: I made this food with my own hands.

examples.text: عجنت خليط اللوز بإيدي اليوم الصبح.
examples.trans: I mixed the almond batter by hand this morning.

meanings.note: With wax.

examples.text: لزقنا الورقة بالشمع.
examples.trans: We stuck the paper with wax.

examples.text: المغلف مختوم بالشمع الأحمر.
examples.trans: The envelope is sealed with red wax.

meanings.note: Exactly, precisely.

examples.text: هذا اللي كنت بدي أحكيه بالضبط.
examples.trans: This is exactly what I wanted to say.

examples.text: وصلنا الساعة تسعة بالضبط.
examples.trans: We arrived at nine o'clock sharp.

meanings.note: Used to describe a location inside a hotel or building lobby.

examples.text: أنا بستناك باللوبي تبع الفندق.
examples.trans: I am waiting for you in the hotel lobby.

examples.text: الضيوف بستنوا باللوبي جنب الاستقبال.
examples.trans: The guests are waiting in the lobby next to reception.

meanings.note: Everyday Jordanian word for beginning an action or event.

examples.text: الحفلة بتبلش الساعة ثمانية.
examples.trans: The party starts at eight o'clock.

examples.text: المسابقة بتبلش بعد عشر دقايق.
examples.trans: The competition starts in ten minutes.

meanings.note: Used to state similarity between people or things.

examples.text: البنت بتشبه أمها كثير.
examples.trans: The girl resembles her mother a lot.

examples.text: نكهة المليسة بتشبه قشر الليمون الطازج.
examples.trans: The flavour of lemon balm resembles fresh lemon peel.

meanings.note: Used when talking about items kept in one's clothing pocket.

examples.text: تلفوني بجيبي.
examples.trans: My phone is in my pocket.

examples.text: خليت بطاقة الدخول بجيبي عشان ما تضيع.
examples.trans: I kept the entry card in my pocket so it would not get lost.

meanings.note: Commonly used regarding time, indicating morning hours or ahead of schedule.

examples.text: صحيت اليوم بدري.
examples.trans: I woke up early today.

examples.text: طلعنا من البيت بدري قبل زحمة السوق.
examples.trans: We left the house early before the market crowd.

meanings.note: Refers to being outdoors or outside a specific location.

examples.text: الأولاد بيلعبوا برا.
examples.trans: The kids are playing outside.

examples.text: الأولاد بلعبوا برا بالساحة جنب الشجر.
examples.trans: The children are playing outside in the courtyard beside the trees.

meanings.note: Indicates location within a street or on a specific road.

examples.text: شفتك بشارع الجامعة.
examples.trans: I saw you on University Street.

examples.text: المكتبة بشارع هادي قريب من الساحة.
examples.trans: The library is on a quiet street near the square.

بشكل.gloss: in a way / in a shape

meanings.en: in a way / in a shape
meanings.note: Often used as a prefix for adverbs, e.g., 'bi-shakil ʿām' (generally).

examples.text: لازم نشتغل بشكل أسرع.
examples.trans: We need to work in a faster way.

examples.text: المكونات مخلوطة بشكل متساوي تماما.
examples.trans: The ingredients are mixed in a completely even way.

meanings.note: Plural of 'biṭāqa', can mean playing cards, identity cards, or event tickets.

examples.text: شريت بطاقات للمباراة.
examples.trans: I bought tickets for the match.

examples.text: وزعنا بطاقات التذوق على كل الطاولات.
examples.trans: We handed out the tasting cards across all the tables.

meanings.note: Used to say "we are walking" or "let us go".

examples.text: يلا بنمشي هسا.
examples.trans: Come on, let's walk now.

examples.text: كل يوم المسا بنمشي سوا بالحديقة.
examples.trans: Every evening we walk together in the garden.

meanings.note: Refers to a gate belonging to a group (us).

examples.text: بوابتنا مسكرة اليوم.
examples.trans: Our gate is closed today.

examples.text: بوابتنا الخشب بتطل مباشرة عالساحة القديمة.
examples.trans: Our wooden gate looks directly out onto the old courtyard.

meanings.note: Used for navigation or metaphorically for direction.

examples.text: ضاع بالصحراء لأنه ما كان معه بوصلة.
examples.trans: He got lost in the desert because he didn't have a compass.

examples.text: اتبعنا إبرة البوصلة لحد ما وصلنا الشرق.
examples.trans: We followed the compass needle until we reached the east.

meanings.note: Used to explain or clarify a point.

examples.text: هذا الاشي بيعني انه احنا خلصنا.
examples.trans: This thing means that we are finished.

examples.text: هادا الرمز بيعني إنه الغرفة مسكرة من جوا.
examples.trans: This symbol means that the room is locked from inside.

meanings.note: The feminine form of the Levantine possessive marker.

examples.text: الشنطة تبعت ريم ضاعت.
examples.trans: Reem's bag is lost.

examples.text: العلبة تبعت الشاي الأخضر عالرف التاني.
examples.trans: The green tea tin is on the second shelf.

meanings.note: Used to indicate first-person possession.

examples.text: هذا الكتاب تبعي، مش تبعك.
examples.trans: This book is mine, not yours.

examples.text: الدفتر تبعي لسه مفتوح عالطاولة.
examples.trans: My notebook is still open on the table.

meanings.note: Describes the action of protecting or guarding a place.

examples.text: هي بتحرس البناية بالليل.
examples.trans: She guards the building at night.

examples.text: القطة قاعدة عند البوابة كأنها بتحرس الحديقة.
examples.trans: The cat is sitting by the gate as if guarding the garden.

meanings.note: Action of a group of people opening something.

examples.text: لا تفتحوا الباب للغريب.
examples.trans: Do not open the door for a stranger.

examples.text: قبل ما تفتحوا الصندوق اقراوا التعليمات منيح.
examples.trans: Before you open the chest, read the instructions carefully.

meanings.note: Used to emphasize absolute completion or exactness.

examples.text: أنا متفق معك تماما.
examples.trans: I agree with you completely.

examples.text: النتيجة طلعت متل ما توقعنا تماما.
examples.trans: The result turned out exactly as we expected.

meanings.note: Used to mean 'even' (e.g., even he went) or 'until' (e.g., until tomorrow).

examples.text: ما أكلت ولا إشي، حتى تفاحة.
examples.trans: I didn't eat anything, not even an apple.

examples.text: ما فتحنا الصندوق حتى قرأنا كل البطاقات.
examples.trans: We did not open the box until we read all the cards.

meanings.note: The standard Levantine colloquial word for 'someone' or 'anyone' (in negative sentences).

examples.text: في حدا هون؟
examples.trans: Is anyone here?

examples.text: في حدا بعرف وين نحفظت الخريطة؟
examples.trans: Does anyone know where the map was stored?

meanings.note: Refers to personal calculations, accounts, or expectations about a situation.

examples.text: الموضوع طلع برا حساباتي.
examples.trans: The matter went beyond my calculations.

examples.text: حسب حساباتي، الكيكة بتطلع من الفرن بعد دقيقتين.
examples.trans: According to my calculations, the cake comes out of the oven in two minutes.

meanings.note: One of the most frequently used adjectives in Jordanian Arabic to mean beautiful, sweet, nice, or good.

examples.text: الفستان هذا كثير حلو عليك.
examples.trans: This dress is very beautiful on you.

examples.text: طعم العسل مع قشر البرتقال حلو ومتوازن.
examples.trans: The taste of honey with orange peel is sweet and balanced.

meanings.note: A literal physical step or a metaphorical step in a process.

examples.text: خلينا نمشي خطوة خطوة.
examples.trans: Let's walk step by step.

examples.text: كل خطوة بهاللغز بتقربنا من المخبز القديم.
examples.trans: Every step in this puzzle brings us closer to the old bakery.

meanings.note: The word 'doctor' with a second person masculine singular possessive suffix.

examples.text: شو حكى لك دكتورك؟
examples.trans: What did your doctor tell you?

examples.text: دكتورك كتبلك وصفة سهلة ومريحة.
examples.trans: Your doctor wrote you an easy, convenient prescription.

meanings.note: Common everyday verb for 'went' in the past tense. Also used as a future particle.

examples.text: راح على الشغل الصبح.
examples.trans: He went to work in the morning.

examples.text: رامي راح عالمكتبة يدور على الكتاب القديم.
examples.trans: Rami went to the library to look for the old book.

meanings.note: Future tense marker in Jordanian and Levantine Arabic, equivalent to 'sa-' in MSA.

examples.text: رح أسافر بكرة.
examples.trans: I will travel tomorrow.

examples.text: رح نذوق التلات كيكات بعد ما يبردوا شوي.
examples.trans: We will taste the three cakes after they cool a little.

meanings.note: Describes light, sun, or colors that are bright and radiant.

examples.text: الشمس ساطعة اليوم.
examples.trans: The sun is shining bright today.

examples.text: الشمس ساطعة عالبلكونة من الصبح بدري.
examples.trans: The sun has been bright on the balcony since early morning.

meanings.note: Everyday word for a knife. Can be pronounced 'sikkiin' or 'sikkiina'.

examples.text: هات السكينة عشان نقطع الكيك.
examples.trans: Bring the knife so we can cut the cake.

examples.text: قصينا الكيكة بسكينة رفيعة عشان تطلع مرتبة.
examples.trans: We cut the cake with a thin knife so it comes out neat.

meanings.note: Imperative verb used when telling a single male to look or see.

examples.text: شوف العصفور على الشجرة.
examples.trans: Look at the bird on the tree.

examples.text: شوف الرقم المكتوب بقلم الرصاص عالزاوية!
examples.trans: Look at the number written in pencil in the corner!

meanings.note: Adjective used for size (small) or age (young), masculine singular.

examples.text: عندي أخ صغير عمره خمس سنين.
examples.trans: I have a young brother who is five years old.

examples.text: في مفتاح نحاس صغير مخبي تحت الورقة.
examples.trans: There is a small brass key hidden under the sheet.

meanings.note: Very common Levantine verb meaning to stay, remain, or keep doing something.

examples.text: ضل بالبيت وما طلع.
examples.trans: He stayed at home and didn't go out.

examples.text: ضل الدفتر مفتوح عالطاولة طول الليل.
examples.trans: The notebook remained open on the table all night.

meanings.note: Can refer to physical length, height, or duration of time (e.g., all day).

examples.text: ظل نايم طول اليوم.
examples.trans: He stayed asleep all day long.

examples.text: مشينا على طول السور القديم لحد البوابة.
examples.trans: We walked along the length of the old wall up to the gate.

meanings.note: Past tense verb for third person plural.

examples.text: الولاد عدوا المصاري.
examples.trans: The boys counted the money.

examples.text: الأولاد عدوا عشر خطوات من الباب للنافورة.
examples.trans: The children counted ten steps from the door to the fountain.

meanings.note: Extremely common colloquial conjunction used to indicate reason or purpose.

examples.text: رحت عالدكتور عشان أنا مريض.
examples.trans: I went to the doctor because I am sick.

examples.text: استعملنا ورق نشافة عشان الحبر ما يطبع.
examples.trans: We used blotting paper so the ink would not stain.

meanings.note: The number twenty.

examples.text: عمره عشرين سنة.
examples.trans: He is twenty years old.

examples.text: المخبز بشتغل بنفس الوصفة من عشرين سنة.
examples.trans: The bakery has been using the same recipe for twenty years.

meanings.note: Can refer to a cardboard box, a tin can, or a small container.

examples.text: افتح علبة التونة.
examples.trans: Open the can of tuna.

examples.text: البطاقات مرتبة جوا علبة صفيح مدهونة أزرق.
examples.trans: The cards are arranged inside a tin box painted blue.

meanings.note: Standard preposition for 'on', 'upon', or 'to'.

examples.text: الكتاب على الطاولة.
examples.trans: The book is on the table.

examples.text: حطينا الخريطة على الطاولة وبلشنا نحللها.
examples.trans: We laid the map on the table and began analysing it.

meanings.note: A very common preposition used to indicate location, possession, or presence.

examples.text: السيارة عند الباب.
examples.trans: The car is at the door.

examples.text: التقينا عند برج الساعة الساعة عشرة.
examples.trans: We met by the clock tower at ten o'clock.

meanings.note: Preposition for 'in' or 'at', and very commonly used to mean 'there is/are' (existential).

examples.text: في ناس كثير بالسوق.
examples.trans: There are many people in the market.

examples.text: في تلات بطاقات ملونة جوا الظرف الكبير.
examples.trans: There are three coloured cards inside the big envelope.

meanings.note: Preposition and adverb for time or sequence meaning 'prior to' or 'before'.

examples.text: لازم أوصل قبل الساعة خمسة.
examples.trans: I have to arrive before five o'clock.

examples.text: غسلنا الفواكه منيح قبل ما نقطعها للتذوق.
examples.trans: We washed the fruit thoroughly before slicing it for the tasting.

meanings.note: The primary interrogative word for quantity, price, or duration in Levantine Arabic.

examples.text: قديش حق هالكتاب؟
examples.trans: How much does this book cost?

examples.text: قديش ضايل وقت حتى تطلع الصينية التانية من الفرن؟
examples.trans: How much time is left until the second tray comes out of the oven?

meanings.note: Everyday Jordanian word for soon or near.

examples.text: راح أوصل قريب جدا.
examples.trans: I will arrive very soon.

examples.text: سلمى رح ترجع قريب ومعها مرطبان العسل الجبلي.
examples.trans: Salma will be back soon bringing the jar of mountain honey.

meanings.note: A highly versatile quantifier used to mean 'all of', 'every', or 'the whole'.

examples.text: كل الناس بتحب الصيف.
examples.trans: All people love summer.

examples.text: كل بطاقة بالعلبة بتحكي عن نبتة عطرية مختلفة.
examples.trans: Every card in the tin talks about a different aromatic plant.

meanings.note: Used to mark the limit of a time period, distance, or extent in colloquial Jordanian.

examples.text: رح أستنى لحد ما تيجي.
examples.trans: I will wait until you come.

examples.text: استنينا بالساحة لحد ما دقت الساعة تمانية.
examples.trans: We waited in the courtyard until the clock struck eight.

meanings.note: An alternative spelling and pronunciation variant of 'لسا', used widely in the Levant.

examples.text: لسه عم بدرس للامتحان.
examples.trans: I am still studying for the exam.

examples.text: مازن لسه عم بدور عالبطاقة الأخيرة بالدرج.
examples.trans: Mazen is still searching for the final card in the drawer.

meanings.note: Directional phrase guiding movement or pointing out a location towards the east.

examples.text: امشي للشرق وبعدين لف يمين.
examples.trans: Walk to the east and then turn right.

examples.text: اتجهنا للشرق خمسين متر لعند البوابة التانية.
examples.trans: We headed to the east fifty metres up to the second gate.

meanings.note: Indicates an object, message, or action directed towards the boss or manager.

examples.text: ابعت هاد الإيميل للمدير.
examples.trans: Send this email to the manager.

examples.text: سلمنا التقرير النهائي للمدير بمكتبه.
examples.trans: We handed the final report to the manager in his office.

meanings.note: Used mostly as a negative particle for verbs ('didn't') or as a relative pronoun/conjunction ('what' or 'that which').

examples.text: ما أكلت إشي من الصبح.
examples.trans: I haven't eaten anything since the morning.

examples.text: ما عرفت إنه العلبة فيها طابق سري من تحت.
examples.trans: I did not know that the box had a secret compartment underneath.

meanings.note: Denotes a square shape or a square area in geometry or real-world objects.

examples.text: ارسم مربع على الورقة.
examples.trans: Draw a square on the paper.

examples.text: رسمنا مربع صغير جنب كل رقم عالورقة.
examples.trans: We drew a small square next to each number on the sheet.

meanings.note: As an adjective (mrattabeh), it means a tidy feminine noun. As a noun (martabeh), it means a rank/status or a mattress.

examples.text: هي بنت مرتبة ومهذبة.
examples.trans: She is a tidy and polite girl.

examples.text: خزانة المطبخ مرتبة والمرطبانات مصفوفة بالألوان.
examples.trans: The kitchen cupboard is tidy and the jars are lined up by colour.

meanings.note: Commonly used in Jordanian Arabic instead of the MSA word 'mughlaq'.

examples.text: المحل مسكر اليوم.
examples.trans: The shop is closed today.

examples.text: باب المخبز مسكر هلق لأنهم طلعوا عالسوق.
examples.trans: The bakery door is closed right now because they went out to the market.

meanings.note: The most common negation particle in Levantine Arabic for non-verbs.

examples.text: أنا مش زعلان منك.
examples.trans: I am not upset with you.

examples.text: هادا المفتاح مش للباب الرئيسي، هادا للخزانة.
examples.trans: This key is not for the main door; this one is for the cupboard.

meanings.note: Refers to a paper envelope used for letters or documents.

examples.text: حطيت المصاري في مغلف.
examples.trans: I put the money in an envelope.

examples.text: حطينا البطاقات كلها جوا مغلف ورق بني.
examples.trans: We put all the cards inside a brown paper envelope.

meanings.note: Used for both a workplace (office) and the piece of furniture (desk).

examples.text: بستناك في مكتبي.
examples.trans: I am waiting for you in my office.

examples.text: لقينا الخريطة التانية جوا درج مكتب جدي.
examples.trans: We found the second map inside my grandfather's desk drawer.

meanings.note: Often used as a noun meaning 'letter' (mail) or 'destiny' in traditional contexts.

examples.text: الاسم مكتوب على اللوحة.
examples.trans: The name is written on the board.

examples.text: الرقم مكتوب بخط صغير تحت الختم الأحمر.
examples.trans: The number is written in small handwriting beneath the red seal.

meanings.note: Used on signs or to indicate rules against doing something.

examples.text: التدخين ممنوع هون.
examples.trans: Smoking is forbidden here.

examples.text: ممنوع حدا يفتح الصينية قبل ما يخلص التوقيت.
examples.trans: Nobody is allowed to open the tin before the timer finishes.

meanings.note: One of the most basic Arabic prepositions indicating origin.

examples.text: أنا من الأردن.
examples.trans: I am from Jordan.

examples.text: جبنا العسل البلدي الصافي من مزرعة قريبة.
examples.trans: We brought the pure local honey from a nearby farm.

meanings.note: Used for physically following someone or metaphorically following rules/ideas.

examples.text: لازم نتبع التعليمات.
examples.trans: We must follow the instructions.

examples.text: لازم نتبع كل خطوة بالوصفة عشان تطلع الكيكة هشة.
examples.trans: We must follow every step in the recipe so the cake turns out fluffy.

meanings.note: Used for physical motion or starting to take action.

examples.text: تأخرنا، لازم نتحرك هسا.
examples.trans: We are late, we need to move now.

examples.text: صار لازم نتحرك عالسوق قبل ما يسكر محل العسل.
examples.trans: We need to head out to the market now before the honey shop closes.

meanings.note: Adjective indicating something is made of or related to copper.

examples.text: اشترى تحفة نحاسية قديمة.
examples.trans: He bought an old copper antique.

examples.text: لقينا ميدالية نحاسية مدورة تحت شجرة الزيزفون.
examples.trans: We found a round brass medallion under the linden tree.

meanings.note: Used for rules, computer systems, or political regimes.

examples.text: لازم نمشي على النظام.
examples.trans: We must follow the system.

examples.text: رتبنا البطاقات حسب نظام ألوان وأرقام واضح.
examples.trans: We arranged the cards according to a clear system of colours and numbers.

meanings.note: Everyday demonstrative pronoun for feminine singular objects.

examples.text: هاي البنت ذكية كثير.
examples.trans: This girl is very smart.

examples.text: هاي الطريقة أسهل بكثير من اللي جربناها امبارح.
examples.trans: This method is much easier than the one we tried yesterday.

meanings.note: Conjunction attached to the first person plural pronoun.

examples.text: صارت مشكلة وإحنا مروحين.
examples.trans: A problem happened while we were going home.

examples.text: نزل المطر فجأة وإحنا ماشيين بالشارع.
examples.trans: The rain suddenly came down while we were walking down the street.

meanings.note: Cardinal number or used as an indefinite pronoun.

examples.text: في واحد بيسأل عنك.
examples.trans: There is someone asking about you.

examples.text: اشتريت كتاب واحد بس من المعرض لأنه كان غالي.
examples.trans: I bought just one book from the fair because it was expensive.

meanings.note: Refers to the morning meal.

examples.text: شربنا قهوة والفطور كان زاكي.
examples.trans: We drank coffee and the breakfast was delicious.

examples.text: طلبنا حمص وفول والفطور وصل بعد عشر دقايق.
examples.trans: We ordered hummus and fava beans, and breakfast arrived ten minutes later.

meanings.note: Can be used as a noun meaning 'and a stamp' or a verb in the past tense 'and he stamped/sealed'.

examples.text: أعطاني ورقة وختم عليها.
examples.trans: He gave me a paper and stamped on it.

examples.text: راجع المدير المعاملة وختم عليها بنفس اللحظة.
examples.trans: The manager reviewed the paperwork and stamped it on the spot.

meanings.note: Imperative verb used to instruct a group of people to take something.

examples.text: تعالوا وخذوا أغراضكم.
examples.trans: Come and take your belongings.

examples.text: جهزوا شناتيكم وخذوا معكم مي كافية للرحلة.
examples.trans: Pack your bags and take enough water with you for the trip.

meanings.note: Everyday item, combined with the conjunction 'wa' (and).

examples.text: جبت قلم ودفتر.
examples.trans: I brought a pen and a notebook.

examples.text: اشتريتله حقيبة ودفتر رسم لأول يوم مدرسة.
examples.trans: I bought him a backpack and a sketchbook for the first day of school.

meanings.note: Singular form for a flower, highly used in everyday speech.

examples.text: قطفت وردة من الحديقة.
examples.trans: I picked a rose from the garden.

examples.text: قدم لوالدته وردة جورية بمناسبة عيد الأم.
examples.trans: He gave his mother a Damask rose for Mother's Day.

meanings.note: Often used when describing the weather.

examples.text: اليوم الجو حلو وشمس طالعة.
examples.trans: Today the weather is nice and the sun is out.

examples.text: الجو ربيع وشمس دافية بتشجع عالقعدة بالبلكونة.
examples.trans: The weather is springlike with a warm sun inviting us to sit on the balcony.

meanings.note: General term for time or duration.

examples.text: ما عندي وقت أطلع اليوم.
examples.trans: I don't have time to go out today.

examples.text: بياخد الطريق من عمان لعجلون تقريباً وقت ساعة.
examples.trans: The road from Amman to Ajloun takes roughly an hour of time.

meanings.note: Used in negative constructions or as a strong negative emphasis.

examples.text: ولا واحد فيهم إجا.
examples.trans: Not even one of them came.

examples.text: سألت الكل بس ولا حدا بيعرف وين حطوا المفتاح.
examples.trans: I asked everyone, yet not a single person knows where they put the key.

meanings.note: Can mean a desk or an office room.

examples.text: استأجرنا شقة ومكتب.
examples.trans: We rented an apartment and an office.

examples.text: في الغرفة الجديدة في تخت وخزانة ومكتب للدراسة.
examples.trans: In the new room there is a bed, a closet, and a desk for studying.

meanings.note: The standard interrogative adverb for location in the dialect.

examples.text: وين رايح؟
examples.trans: Where are you going?

examples.text: وين حطيت مفاتيح السيارة بعد ما رجعت من الشغل؟
examples.trans: Where did you put the car keys after you got back from work?

meanings.note: Present tense verb, also used for future with the prefix 'b'.

examples.text: رح يطلع من الشغل وييجي عندنا.
examples.trans: He will leave work and come to us.

examples.text: استنى شوي هون عبين ما يخلص صاحبي وييجي لعندنا.
examples.trans: Wait here a moment until my friend finishes and comes over to us.

meanings.note: Vocative particle used when addressing someone directly.

examples.text: يا أحمد، تعال هون.
examples.trans: Oh Ahmed, come here.

examples.text: يا سيدي، تفضل اشرب معنا فنجان قهوة قبل ما تروح.
examples.trans: Sir, please come have a cup of coffee with us before you leave.

meanings.note: Third person masculine singular verb with a first person plural object pronoun.

examples.text: بدي الباص ياخذنا على الجامعة.
examples.trans: I want the bus to take us to the university.

examples.text: أبوي بده ياخذنا بالسيارة يوم الجمعة على جرش.
examples.trans: My dad wants to take us by car to Jerash on Friday.

meanings.note: Often means to quit doing something or to stop functioning.

examples.text: لازم يبطل دخان.
examples.trans: He must quit smoking.

examples.text: قرّر يبطل سهر بالليل عشان يصحى نشيط عالدوام.
examples.trans: He decided to quit staying up late at night so he wakes up fresh for work.

meanings.note: 'yruh' means 'he goes', 'yrawweh' often means 'he goes home'.

examples.text: بده يروح على السوق.
examples.trans: He wants to go to the market.

examples.text: لازم يروح عالبنك الصبح قبل ما تخلص ساعات الدوام.
examples.trans: He has to go to the bank in the morning before business hours end.

meanings.note: Very common interjection used to urge action or to say goodbye ('yalla bye').

examples.text: يلا نطلع، تأخرنا.
examples.trans: Come on let's go, we're late.

examples.text: يلا البس جاكيتك بسرعة، الأوبر صار واقف تحت.
examples.trans: Come on, put your jacket on quickly—the Uber is already waiting downstairs.

meanings.note: Verb indicating physical contact.

examples.text: ممنوع حدا يلمس الأغراض.
examples.trans: No one is allowed to touch the things.

examples.text: الطفل بحب يلمس كل الأغراض اللي عالرفوف بالمحل.
examples.trans: The toddler loves touching all the items on the shelves in the store.
